response.sql: SELECT AVG(group_avg_fillcount) AS average_of_group_averages FROM (SELECT AVG(e.fillcount) AS group_avg_fillcount FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark WHERE e.expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.orderflow) AS grouped_executions
